Forced saves yield to the game's own.

## Server

### Fixed
- The five-minute forced save no longer fires when the game's active slot file changed within the last ten minutes. The game autosaves on its own every ~150 seconds through an async path that duplicates the save object; a forced save landing one second after one of those crashed the game inside its own save subsystem (null dereference, nobody online, 2026-09-11). The forced save was only ever a floor for a game that has stopped saving, and it still fires after ten quiet minutes. The file mirror keeps running on every sweep.
